reviews.rationale: Mandatory pre-interpretation verification of both actual CARDS.json and SOURCE_BINDINGS.json returned ok=false with invalid_source_roots. Verification stopped before input or source processing. The explicit allowed directory jobs/hathi-gpo-orders/output/texts is absent from the supplied confined source root. The input contract requires stopping on any other unresolved byte/span/binding defect, so no scientific source interpretation or lifecycle conclusion is issued for this card. No source, card, path configuration or claim was repaired.
qualifications: Exact input hashes independently matched the two expected SHA256 pins using the maintained verifier byte-reading helper. Canonical claim_sha256 was computed with the maintained verifier canonical hash helper; the CLI reports contain no card hash because root validation failed first.

Every quoted reference matched a supplied descriptor exactly after removing raw_path; each nonquotation confirmation matched at least one descriptor on instrument_id, grade, sha256, text_path and text_sha256. These are structural comparisons only: no descriptor earned raw/text/span byte verification.

The actual-card mechanical report is retained verbatim as a failure. Because invalid_source_roots preceded reference processing, it emitted no raw_path_missing or quote_offsets entries; their absence is not a pass or resolution of the stated native-contract coverage limitations.

Complete retained source text and quoted spans were not read for scientific interpretation; identity, command inventory, first or earlier endings, carried scope, separate further exemption, chronology, savings and current predicate remain unadjudicated.
Source grade remains machine_read_government_printed_copy, acceptable_as_original=false. No authentication, custody inference, page confirmation, scientific approval or human certification.
